title: Constructive Total Loss — Economic Threshold
citation: Illustrative Motor Comprehensive Policy — Section 4 (Loss Settlement), Clause 4.1
text: The Insurer shall consider the insured vehicle a Constructive Total Loss if the certified estimated cost of repairing the accidental damage exceeds 50% of the insured declared vehicle value immediately prior to the collision event. Settlement shall be computed based on the pre-accident agreed value less any applicable policy deductible.
